description.value: Tealips Cafe is a bubble tea and café in Burnaby's Highgate neighbourhood offering an extensive menu of milk teas, fruit slushes, smoothies, and coffee alongside fresh Belgian waffles made in-house with organic Kefir. The kitchen also turns out freshly toasted focaccia sandwiches and Korean-style bingsoo shaved ice, making it a solid stop for a substantial snack or light meal. The café appears to operate a second Metrotown location as well, with online ordering available for both.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content clearly confirms Tealips Cafe at 7139 Arcola Way, Burnaby with phone (778) 397-3972 not present in OSM. Takeout is the core business model with prominent 'Order Now' and 'Order Online' links throughout the site. The menu explicitly labels the avocado sandwich as 'a vegetarian favorite' and notes oat milk substitution is available; no bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM tags do not include a phone number; phone (778) 397-3972 sourced from website only.
Order page references a second location ('METROTOWN') with pickup address 110-6125 Sussex Ave — the OSM record corresponds only to the Highgate location at 7139 Arcola Way.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café with a functioning website, online ordering, and confirmed address. Straightforwardly includable as a food and drink stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Avocado Sandwich described as 'a vegetarian favorite'; oat milk substitution available for drinks (dairy-free). No explicit vegan or GF claims confirmed
